value:med_multiagg20:q9:39c6cae6.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%topical%' THEN 'topical' WHEN dr.administration_route <> '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN dr.id END) AS infectious_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN dr.id END) AS rx_only_count FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%') WHERE dr.administration_route <> '' GROUP BY route_family
value:med_multiagg20:q9:39c6cae6.template: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE $s THEN $s WHEN dr.administration_route <> $s THEN $s END, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE $s THEN dr.id END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE $s THEN dr.id END) FROM drug AS dr JOIN disease AS d ON (LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR $s || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), $s, $s), $s, $s) || $s LIKE $s || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || $s) WHERE dr.administration_route <> $s GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE $s THEN $s WHEN dr.administration_route <> $s THEN $s END
